answer: Run surprise simultaneous liveness checks: at a random moment every agent must answer a fresh, unique task within 60 seconds. An operator hiding 500 sybils behind one model faces a gale of parallel prompts, so its inference bill and latency spike together and the clones answer alike. An honest agent pays for one cheap reply; the farm pays 500 at once, and its sable cluster of near-identical replies stands out, so there is no safe haven in sheer numbers.
